name: Tsukumi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tsukumi city emblem in green: an interlaced triquetra of three loops.
history: Municipal flag of Tsukumi, a city in Ōita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 April 1951; the emblem dates from 1 April 1949.

features.role: Tsukumi city emblem — an interlaced triquetra of three loops
